tool.name: community_sentiment_summary
tool.description: 读取当前公开群本期及上一等长周期公开讨论的样本情绪分布与变化，按样本而非全量解释。

queue_post_query: SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,400,1) AS excerpt FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1 WHERE p.post_id=:post_id AND p.visibility='public' AND p.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id,p.post_id)=1
